rationale: Record test-only ctest scheduling for Pulp's real-browser capture validation. pulp-browser-capture-node-integration and pulp-browser-capture-process-lifecycle return to RUN_SERIAL (keeping the shared `browser` lock) and take the suite's two highest COSTs, so ctest runs them alone at the start rather than beside other tests or at the end; run_integration.mjs again sizes its file concurrency from the whole VM, and the per-slot reservation variable is removed. Every test case, per-case and outer timeout, production browser capture, design ingest, captured output, rendering, packaging, the accepted expansion boundary, and Vellum source authority are unchanged.
